defect.description: parseTarget applies the '/' authority/endpoint split even when the target contains no '://' scheme separator, so a scheme-less target such as 'unix:/path/to/socket' is decomposed into Authority 'unix:' and Endpoint 'path/to/socket', handing the resolver a mangled endpoint instead of the original target.
defect.provenance: fix PR #1611 (commit 0d57c57): parseTarget returns the target unsplit when no scheme separator is present
